## WAIT states

| WAIT reason | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `WAIT_ENVIRONMENT` | The required execution environment is not yet available; wait and re-check. |
| `WAIT_RESOURCE` | A required resource is not yet available; wait and re-check. |
| `WAIT_LICENSE` | A required license clearance is not yet available; wait and re-check. |
| `WAIT_PLATFORM` | A required platform capability is not yet available; wait and re-check. |
| `WAIT_AUTHORITY` | A required authority sign-off is not yet available; wait and re-check. |
| `WAIT_CAPABILITY` | A required capability has no available adapter (it is unknown, future, or remote_required); the router waits rather than falling back to a local substitute. |
| `WAIT_REMOTE_EXECUTOR` | A plan's summed resource estimates exceed the admission caps for its resource class; a remote executor is required and the planner waits rather than silently overflowing local. |

Failures are evidence. They are not approval to trade, deploy, restart,
write protected storage or perform target-specific security work.
